data.name: Name
data.execution_enabled: Allow device commands (off means preview only)
data.always_confirm_risky: Always confirm before unlocking or opening
data.inline_entity_descriptions: Describe every entity inside the question
data.bypass_local_intents: Handle every command, including ones Home Assistant recognises

data_description.always_confirm_risky: Ask first before unlocking a door, opening a garage or disarming an alarm, however sure the model is. Turning this off lets confident requests through silently.
data_description.inline_entity_descriptions: Costs roughly twice the tokens. Only worth turning on if the agent picks the wrong device.
data_description.bypass_local_intents: By default Home Assistant's own sentence matcher keeps the phrasings it recognises, and only sends the rest here. Turn this on to send everything here instead.
